gloss: hermit; recluse; person who has renounced the world

definitions.gloss: hermit; recluse; person who has renounced the world
definitions.explanation: A person who has withdrawn from society and worldly concerns. Can refer to historical hermits, monks, or modern people who live in isolation by choice.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}のように{暮|く}らしている。
{山奥|やまおく}で{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}のような{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: He leads a reclusive life deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {定年|ていねん}{後|ご}、{都会|とかい}を{離|はな}れて{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}のように{田舎|いなか}で{静|しず}かに{暮|く}らしたい。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to leave the city and live quietly in the countryside like a hermit.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "person who has abandoned the world" ({世|よ} = the world + {捨|す}てる = to abandon + {人|びと} = person). Has a literary, somewhat romantic nuance. Often used metaphorically rather than literally — describing someone who lives very simply or avoids social engagement.

NOTE: In Japanese literary tradition, there are famous {世捨|よす}て{人|びと} such as the poet {鴨|かもの}{長明|ちょうめい}, author of {方丈記|ほうじょうき}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隠者|いんじゃ}: hermit, recluse — more formal, literary
- {仙人|せんにん}: hermit, sage — mythical/supernatural connotation
- {引|ひ}きこもり: shut-in — modern term, negative connotation
